title: ONSure Counterevidence Disposition v1
description: docs/master/semantic-assurance/158_LEARNING_VALIDATION_P0_CONTRADICTION_POLICY_BINDINGS.md class 8 (Counterevidence vs Privacy), bound per contracts/learning-validation-p0-contradiction-contract-bindings.candidate.v1.json LC-P0-008 (EvidenceObservation, CounterevidenceDisposition). '158 SS8: privacy를 이유로 불리한 증거만 제거하지 않는다' -- when is_counterevidence=true, DELETE is reachable only with a real deletion_basis (LEGAL_REQUIREMENT or DATA_SUBJECT_ERASURE_RIGHT), never PRIVACY_PREFERENCE_ONLY alone: that is exactly the named negative case (removing only unfavorable evidence under a privacy pretext), so the schema forbids it as a combination, not just discourages it.
